title: European Household Internet Access (2010–2024)
prompt: The bar chart illustrates the percentage of households with access to high-speed internet across four European nations (Germany, France, Spain, and Poland) between 2010 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
visualDescription: Bar chart showing growth from 45% to 92% in Germany, 40% to 88% in France, 35% to 84% in Spain, and 28% to 81% in Poland over 14 years.

title: Global Renewable Energy Consumption Trends
prompt: The line graph shows changes in global consumption of solar, wind, and hydroelectric energy between 2000 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
visualDescription: Line graph showing sharp upward trajectory for solar and wind from 2015 onwards, while hydroelectricity maintained steady linear growth.

title: Household Energy Expenditure by Sector
prompt: The pie charts compare household expenditure on heating, cooling, lighting, and appliances in an average European home in 2000 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
visualDescription: Two pie charts illustrating heating dropping from 52% to 38%, while electronic appliances rose from 18% to 31%.

title: Public Transit Usage in 5 World Metropolises
prompt: The table outlines daily metro passenger numbers, average ticket prices, and percentage of zero-emission fleets across London, Tokyo, Paris, New York, and Seoul. Summarise the key comparisons.
visualDescription: Table with 5 cities comparing fleet electrification (Seoul leading at 68%) and passenger volume.

title: Solar Water Desalination Industrial Process
prompt: The diagram illustrates the sequential stages involved in converting seawater into potable drinking water using a solar-powered desalination plant. Summarise the main steps.
visualDescription: Diagram with intake pipe, multi-stage solar evaporator, condensation chamber, mineral enrichment, and distribution storage.

title: Coastal Town Redevelopment (1995 vs Present)
prompt: The two maps compare the coastal town of Portwood in 1995 and after modern redevelopment in the present day. Summarise the major urban transformations.
visualDescription: Maps showing conversion of old industrial docks into pedestrian marina, green park, and modern residential apartments.

title: Exercise vs Balanced Diet for Good Health
prompt: Some people believe that the best way to stay healthy is to do regular exercise, while others think a balanced diet is more important. To what extent do you agree or disagree that exercise is the most crucial factor for good health?

title: Impact of Messaging and Social Media on Relationships
prompt: Many people today prefer to communicate through text messages and social media rather than talking on the phone or in person. Do you agree or disagree that this change has had a negative impact on the quality of our relationships?

title: Government Funding for Public Art vs Essential Services
prompt: Some argue that governments should spend money on public art, such as sculptures and murals, while others believe this money would be better spent on essential public services like healthcare. To what extent do you agree or disagree that funding for public art is a waste of government money?

title: Living Abroad to Understand Foreign Culture
prompt: It is often said that the best way to learn about a new culture is to live in that country for a period of time. To what extent do you agree or disagree that immersion is the only effective way to truly understand a foreign culture?

title: Early Formal Schooling vs Early Years Play
prompt: Some people think that children should begin their formal education at a very early age, while others believe they should spend their early years primarily playing. Do you agree or disagree that starting formal schooling before the age of six is beneficial for a child's development?

title: Remote Work as the Future of Employment
prompt: In many workplaces, employees are encouraged to work from home. Some people believe this is a positive development, while others think it can harm teamwork and company culture. To what extent do you agree or disagree that remote work is the future of employment and is beneficial for both companies and employees?

title: Government-Funded vs Student-Paid University Education
prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for all students, funded by the government. To what extent do you agree or disagree that a university degree should be paid for by the individual student rather than the taxpayer?

title: Online Shopping: Benefits vs Community Impact
prompt: The rise of online shopping has changed the way we buy goods. Some argue that this is a positive trend, while others are concerned about its impact on local communities and the environment. Do you agree or disagree that the benefits of online shopping outweigh its negative consequences?

title: Economic and Social Impact of Ageing Populations
prompt: Many countries are experiencing an ageing population. Some believe that this is a positive sign of societal progress, while others see it as a major economic and social problem. To what extent do you agree or disagree that an ageing population presents more challenges than benefits?

title: News Media: Informing the Public vs Entertainment
prompt: Some people think that the news media has become too focused on entertaining people rather than informing them. To what extent do you agree or disagree that the primary purpose of news should be to educate and inform the public, regardless of whether it is entertaining?

title: Success in Life: Individual Ambition vs Teamwork
prompt: Some people believe that to be successful in a competitive world, individuals must be primarily focused on their own goals and ambitions. Others argue that cooperation and teamwork are the keys to achieving success in both personal and professional life. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Reducing Obesity: Government Taxes vs Individual Responsibility
prompt: Some people think that the government should be responsible for reducing obesity rates by taxing unhealthy foods and subsidising healthy options. Others believe that individuals should be responsible for their own diet and health. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Living Alone: Personal Independence vs Social Isolation
prompt: In the modern world, many people are choosing to live alone. Some argue that this trend reflects a healthy desire for independence, while others believe it leads to increased loneliness and social isolation. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Competitive Sports in Schools: Life Skills vs Pressure
prompt: Some educators believe that competitive sports in schools are essential for teaching children valuable life skills like teamwork and resilience. Others argue that they can be detrimental by placing too much pressure on young people and prioritising winning over participation. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Historic Buildings: Heritage Preservation vs Modern Redevelopment
prompt: Many people believe that historic buildings and monuments should be preserved for future generations. Others argue that old, impractical buildings should be demolished to make way for modern, functional structures. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Internet Impact: Misinformation vs Democratising Knowledge
prompt: Some people believe that the internet has a largely negative effect on society, leading to misinformation and social division. Others argue it is a fundamentally positive tool that has democratised access to information. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Environmental Protection: Government Regulation vs Individual Action
prompt: Some argue that the best way to tackle environmental problems is through government regulation and international agreements. Others believe that individual actions, such as recycling and reducing consumption, are more effective. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Immigration: Cultural Adoption vs Preserving Heritage
prompt: Some people think that when moving to a new country, immigrants should adopt the local culture and customs. Others believe that they should maintain their own cultural traditions while integrating. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: High Salaries for Athletes vs Essential Professions
prompt: Some people believe that professional athletes and entertainers are paid too much money compared to people in more essential professions like doctors and teachers. Others argue that their high salaries are justified by the market and the entertainment they provide. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Advertising: Informing Consumers vs Promoting Materialism
prompt: Some people think that advertising has a positive impact by informing consumers about new products and driving competition. Others believe it is largely negative, as it creates artificial needs and encourages materialism. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

title: Self-Employment and Freelancing in the Modern Economy
prompt: In many countries, an increasing number of people are choosing to work freelance or become self-employed rather than working for a single company. What are the advantages and disadvantages of being self-employed?

title: Online Higher Education vs Traditional Campus Degrees
prompt: An increasing number of students around the world are choosing to study at university online rather than attending a traditional campus. What are the advantages and disadvantages of studying for a degree online?

title: Car-Free Zones in Modern City Centres
prompt: Many cities today have designated zones where cars are banned to reduce pollution and traffic. What are the advantages and disadvantages of implementing car-free zones in city centres?

title: Growth of Tourism in Remote and Natural Regions

title: Artificial Intelligence Replacing Human Customer Service
prompt: Technology companies are increasingly using artificial intelligence to perform tasks previously done by humans, such as customer service. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend for both companies and their customers?

title: Teenagers Studying Abroad: Language and Cultural Exchange
prompt: Many families today send their teenage children to study abroad for a year to improve their language skills and experience a new culture. Do the advantages of this experience for the teenager outweigh the disadvantages?

title: Urban Migration to Rural Communities
prompt: In recent years, there has been a significant increase in the number of people living in large cities moving to rural areas. Do the advantages of this trend, for both the individuals and the rural communities, outweigh the disadvantages?

title: Widespread Credit Card Usage and Consumer Borrowing

title: Children Spending Free Time on Video Games
prompt: More and more children are spending a significant amount of their free time playing video games. Do the advantages of this activity for a child's development outweigh the disadvantages?

title: Listening to Music at the Workplace
prompt: Many companies now allow their employees to listen to music while they work. Do the advantages of this practice for employee productivity and job satisfaction outweigh the disadvantages?

title: Urban Traffic Congestion: Causes and Solutions
prompt: In many major cities, traffic congestion has become a significant problem. What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can be implemented to address them?

title: Rising Household and Business Waste Production

title: Youth Migration to Metropolises and Rural Decline
prompt: Many young people today are leaving their rural hometowns to seek opportunities in large cities, leading to a decline in rural populations. What are the causes of this migration, and what solutions can governments implement to make rural areas more attractive?

title: Rising Anxiety and Depression: Causes and Interventions
prompt: A growing number of people are experiencing mental health issues such as anxiety and depression. What are the primary causes of this trend, and what solutions can be suggested to address this problem?

title: Unhealthy Work-Life Balance: Hazards and Solutions
prompt: Many people find it difficult to balance their work life with their family and personal life. What problems can arise from an unhealthy work-life balance, and what solutions can both employers and employees adopt?

title: STEM Teacher Shortage in Schools
prompt: In several parts of the world, there is a shortage of qualified teachers in schools, particularly in science and mathematics. What are the causes of this shortage, and what solutions could be implemented to attract and retain teachers?

title: Single-Use Plastics Overuse and Pollution
prompt: The overuse of single-use plastics is a major environmental concern. What problems are caused by plastic pollution, and what solutions could governments and businesses implement to reduce it?

title: Social Isolation of the Elderly Population
prompt: Many elderly people live in social isolation and lack regular contact with family or friends. What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can be found to improve the lives of isolated elderly people?

title: Rise of Fast Food vs Home Cooking

title: Minimalist Lifestyle and Owning Fewer Possessions
prompt: In some countries, there is a growing trend of people adopting a minimalist lifestyle, owning fewer possessions. What factors might be driving this trend? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?

title: Young Adults Living Longer with Parents

prompt: There is a growing trend of people using wearable technology, such as smartwatches and fitness trackers. What are the reasons for the increasing popularity of these devices? Are they improving people's lives?
